_comment: Tiny Gadi-oriented regular-grid smoke test for Fe NLTE generation with ASCII departures.
_note: Use with the tiny PBS wrappers at the repo root or directly with turbospectrum_regular_grid_example.pbs.
This config intentionally omits explicit output paths so RUN_ROOT or SCRATCH can control where files land on Gadi.
The grid is deliberately tiny: 2 teff x 1 logg x 2 feh x 1 turbvel = 4 rows.
Fe abundance is derived from [Fe/H] using the Magg 2022 solar abundance adopted by the runtime.
Nearest-file matching makes this safer as a smoke test when only a sparse departure subset is available.

runtime._note: Small shard sizes keep the smoke test quick while still exercising shard generation and merge paths.
